M01: Preview is read-only, paginated and limited to unused assets older than an explicit cutoff of at least 24 hours
M02: Every historical revision, original source and durable outbox frame prevents retirement
M03: Retired assets cannot be completed, read or newly referenced; failed references roll back
M04: SQL serializes retirement against attachment; stale previews never authorize deletion
M05: Exact selections retire atomically; immutable retirement survives lost responses and restart
M06: Version 8 upgrades retain history and conservatively date old assets; failed migration rolls back
M07: Old unreachable tombstoned cards release their asset bytes without deleting immutable revision manifests or source provenance
M08: Live fork descendants retain full ancestry bytes and original sources even through deleted intermediates
M09: Deleted-card cleanup independently observes the full deletion age floor
M10: Retired ancestry cannot be revived through later publications, forks, sync jobs or tombstone removal
M11: SQL serializes later publication roots against deleted-card reclamation so exactly one can succeed
M12: Populated v13 upgrades preserve prior migration history and immutable revisions, with retention DDL and history rolling back together on failure
M13: Pinned private publications and durable sync jobs retain deleted ancestry bytes and source originals
